versions.content: SF - x, FF - x, CF/CF2 and FC frames The behavior shall be as depicted in Table 3 (also for 1:n connections). The ignoring of an FF - E shall be according to the value of FrArTpLm . Regarding CF and CF2 frames there is a special error handling in case Retry is con figured (otherwise CF2 frames are ignored): If the sender starts a block with another frame than expected, i.e. CF instead of CF2 or CF2 instead of CF, then the sender is doing a Retry that has not been requested by the receiver (maybe bec ause of lo sing th e FC - CTS frame on the bus). Therefore, the receiver always has to remember the old block size and send another FC - CTS at the end of this retransmitted block. Errors in the unnecessarily retransmitted block shall be ignored.
